integrity: Exact rational determinant identities, analytic Schur stability inequalities and real-eigenvalue sign argument. A standalone SymPy script independently recomputes the finite algebraic identities. Mathematical correctness and bibliographic comparisons have self-review only.
scientific_limitations: The unstable alternating predecessor schedule is externally prescribed, not proved realizable by endogenous distance-based choices. The open destabilization window is sufficient, not a complete Floquet classification. Independently established priority is not claimed.
title: Two rooted switching trees destabilize a Schur-stable herding filter
